en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a hilltop citadel with extensive stone walls and fortifications overlooking a settlement of small houses on the slopes below. The image is labeled in multiple languages (French and English) identifying the scene as the citadel of Salonica. The style is typical of early 20th‑century printed postcards, with the caption printed in a white border at the bottom.
